evals.prompt: Use TDD to add a discount rule: 10% off orders over $200 for members.
evals.expected_output: Writes a behavior test list, then one test at a time, runs each to see it fail for the right reason, writes minimal code, refactors on green, and commits.
expectations: Writes a test list of behaviors
Runs the test and shows it failing before implementing
Distinguishes failing for the right reason vs import errors

evals.prompt: I already wrote the function, can you add tests and call it TDD?
evals.expected_output: Explains tests-after aren't TDD, and at minimum verifies each new test can fail (e.g. by temporarily breaking the code) before trusting it.
expectations: Says writing tests after isn't TDD
Recommends proving each test can fail
Does not claim the work was test-driven

evals.prompt: Fix this bug: users can redeem the same coupon twice.
evals.expected_output: Starts with a failing regression test reproducing the bug, then fixes and shows it passing.
expectations: Shows it failing with the buggy behavior
Fixes and shows the test passing
Keeps the test as a regression guard
